$comment: The outcome-skills arm registry (plan v3 section 13 step 2, O1; family G per the G admission prereg, sections 2 to 5). Each arm is real_agent-compatible: arms.<name>.limits is what lanes/real-outcome/agent/real_agent.py reads, and turns is what the G rig sends, in order, in one conversation, each after the previous goes quiet under quiet_sec and bg_wait_sec, as real_agent's turns do. The rig must record each message's phase (the turn's) and parent_tool_use_id, which the exposure detectors (exposure.ts) require. {statement} is the task statement with trailing whitespace removed. tests/outcome-skills/registry.test.ts pins every turn text by sha256.
